ends.note: north end at the rear line of the lots fronting Harrison Av.; does not reach Harrison

notes: Mostly open dump land. Names printed without a suffix are written with 'Street': DUCK (NOT IMPROVED), DOLPH (NOT OPENED), McROBERTS, LOWRY. Garrard Avenue runs down the left edge; only its east line and water pipe are drawn, so Garrard/Harrison uses the east line minus 15 ft (the pipe agrees). Duck leaves Garrard's east line at about (123,2637) but the Duck/Garrard centre point falls in the binding gutter (x~30), so it is not recorded here (it is on sheet 221). Dolph is printed only south of McRoberts; the 50 ft street north of McRoberts between blocks 1 and 2 is on exactly the same line, so it is recorded as Dolph; it dead-ends at the rear of the Harrison Av. lots. McRoberts (~41 ft, no width printed) runs straight from Duck across Dolph to Western. On the NE side of Western the Lowry market island (labelled LOWRY) has a ~31 ft roadway on each side: the north roadway is recorded as Lowry Street, the south one as '?' (same arrangement as on sheet 223). Harrison/Western lies just off the top edge (the corner of the 2203 building is at the top of the page) and is not recorded. Western/McLean is off the right edge (McLean's centreline is east of the page; only McLean's NW line is drawn) and is not recorded. Bank Street: north line drawn all along; the south line is drawn only west of Duck, so the Dolph/Bank point uses the north line + 25 ft and sits close to the bottom of the drawn area; McLean/Bank would fall at about (6090,7715), right on the bottom edge, and is not recorded. Duck/Bank is marked cross because the Bank south line stops at Duck's west line (Duck appears to continue south onto sheet 212). The circled numbers (62', 58') are grade marks; the curved line is the edge of the dump.
